title: PEIRA: Learning Predictive Encoders through Inter-View Regressor Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2605.17671v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Non-contrastive self-supervised learning (SSL) is an effective framework for predictive representation learning, but popular (and in practice effective) methods such as SimSiam, BYOL, I-JEPA or DINO, which rely on a form of self-distillation to train a teacher-student network, remain poorly understood as they typically do not minimize a well-defined objective. We analyze the dynamics of a variant of the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) using a regularized linear regressor to predict the learned representations of two views of the data from one another, and fully characterize its stability: non-collapsed stable equilibria align with leading nonlinear canonical correlation subspaces, while collapsed equilibria may also be stable attractors. translated_abstract: 非对比自监督学习（SSL）是预测表示学习的有效框架，但一些流行且在实践中有效的方法，如 SimSiam、BYOL、I-JEPA 或 DINO，它们依赖某种形式的自蒸馏来训练师生网络，由于通常没有最小化一个明确定义的目标函数，因此仍然缺乏充分理解。我们分析了联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的一个变体的动力学，该变体使用正则化线性回归器从彼此预测数据两个视图的学习表示，并完整刻画了其稳定性：未坍缩的稳定平衡点与主导非线性典型相关子空间对齐，而坍缩的平衡点也可能是稳定吸引子。受此结果启发，我们提出了 PEIRA，这是一种非对比 SSL 方法，具有通过最优线性回归器的迹定义的显式目标函数。我们表明其……
tldr: 本文提出 PEIRA，一种具有显式目标函数的非对比自监督学习方法，其目标通过最优线性回归器的迹来定义，并基于理论分析证明 JEPA 变体的未坍缩稳定平衡点与主导非线性典型相关子空间对齐。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes PEIRA, a non-contrastive SSL method with an explicit objective defined by the trace of the optimal linear regressor, grounded in a theoretical analysis showing that non-collapsed stable equilibria of a JEPA variant align with leading nonlinear canonical correlation subspaces.
